en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a Central European city with hills in the background. In the middle distance stands a large Romanesque‑style cathedral with four tall square towers. In the foreground is a long, three‑storey school or institutional building facing a street with small figures walking. At the bottom left of the image the caption reads "Pécs" and at the bottom center "Látkép a Cisztercita reálgimnáziummal." The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address, a brown Hungarian postage stamp, postmarks and a small publisher's logo labeled "WEINSTOCK".
